name: modChads modManager
author: modChad
description: A better Settings → Mods: search, sort and filters, compact rows that open for details, a Problems tab that explains what's wrong (with safe updates), a Reload game button that restarts to the main menu or straight into a save (Mod Reloader is now part of it), All on / All off, links to each mod's own settings, and a Browse online tab for mods.pones.top with an NSFW switch, an optional u.pone.rs downloads switch and a hard block that can't be turned off.
